name: product-info-tabs
title: Product info tabs
description: Description, details, shipping and reviews as tabs on desktop and an accordion on a phone, from the same content.
docs: Give every section a short id: the URL hash #id opens it, and the hash follows the open section. Closed panels stay in the document. Below the breakpoint (768 px by default) the sections become a single-open accordion whose headings use headingLevel. The server renders the tabs, so until the page is interactive a small inline style hides the tab row under the breakpoint and a phone never paints a row that does not fit (a strict style-src policy blocks that rule; the row then scrolls inside itself).
